attempts.notes: Enovix's own post confirms it supplies TAA-compliant cells for ANAFI USA and that these cells are manufactured in Korea (Enovix's Nonsan, South Korea plant, acquired from SolarEdge). No public source names the cathode/anode material supplier or the lithium/cobalt/graphite raw-material producer tied to the ANAFI USA battery, so tiers 2 and 3 are left empty.
